commercial.external_redistribution: Prohibited by current product page; internal-use license and derived-data rights require review.
commercial.free_trial: Up to one month may be available to eligible users who have not previously received the product/trial; not requested.

trade_type_special_handling: QCC, compression, routed, auction, floor, complex and provisional types must be separately classified or quarantined under a preregistered rule.

measurement_advantage_vs_option_sentimen: TBT exposes side, open/close, capacity, trade type and contract size at trade level.
These fields can be crossed directly after raw-row reconstruction; Option Sentiment's 80-field daily aggregate does not expose the same directional cross-tabs.
Execution IDs provide a potential route to pair/complex-leg reconciliation, subject to sample validation.
next_gates: Obtain a lawful representative sample or eligible free trial; do not purchase without approval.
Measure row grain: one execution versus buy/sell-side rows; reconcile EXEC_ID and COMPLEX_EXEC_ID.
Validate side semantics, capacity mapping, open/close, trade-type coverage, NBBO/BBO and late floor timestamps.
Quantify C1 share of total OPRA volume and historical underlying/date coverage, including inactive names.
Obtain actual first-receipt logs and append-only corrections; archive backfill remains retrospective.
Confirm internal-use and derived-feature licensing, fee schedule and data retention terms.
Only then preregister one C1-specific signed/opening-flow hypothesis with prior-return, liquidity, IV and event controls.
non_inferences: CAPACITY is an exchange clearing-origin category, not beneficial-owner identity or proof of informed trading.
SIDE B/S is documented as Buy/Sell; do not call it aggressor direction without an explicit rule/sample validation.
OPEN_CLOSE is not open interest and does not identify a unique beneficial owner's net position.
C1-only activity is not all-OPRA or whole-market options flow.
Execution IDs may link sides/legs; do not sum rows as independent trades until row cardinality is empirically established.

pit_protocol.execution_rule: First actual regular-session open strictly after first receipt; EOD strategy execution no earlier than that session close.
pit_protocol.live_floor_basis: Cboe's 2026-02-20 Traders Weekly states the TBT dataset was launched; this is the first located public launch documentation, not a verified first subscriber receipt.
pit_protocol.receipt_rule: Preserve each file version, first receipt UTC, raw SHA-256, trade date, schema version and correction parent; use only after actual receipt.
pit_protocol.t_plus_one: File is for the prior trade date and typically delivered after midnight ET; use TRADING_DT, not calendar date of TRANSACT_TIME around GTH midnight.

source.delivery: T+1 overnight after midnight ET; typical 00:30-01:30 ET
source.product: Enhanced US Options Trade-by-Trade Execution Detail
